instruction.text: How can you recognise even numbers in the binary system?

hint.label: Even numbers
hint.text: Even numbers are numbers that are divisible by 2.

instruction.text: How can you recognise odd numbers in the binary system?

hint.label: Odd numbers
hint.text: Odd numbers are numbers that are not divisible by 2.

instruction.text: Decide whether the binary number is odd or even.

trainers.hint: To find out whether a binary number is odd or even, simply look at the last digit.

wrong.text:
Even binary numbers end with the digit 0.
Odd binary numbers end with the digit 1.
wrong.sound: Even binary numbers end with the digit zero. Odd binary numbers end with the digit <mat>1</mat>.
